intents.definition: Customer reports that an expected package has not arrived or is delayed beyond the expected delivery date.
Customer reports that a package was marked as delivered but was not received, or is lost/stolen.
Customer received an incorrect or different item than what was ordered.
Customer is inquiring about a refund, hasn't received an expected refund, or has issues with refund processing.
Customer reports payment problems such as double charges, failed payments, or billing errors.
Customer wants to cancel an order or reports issues with order cancellation.
Customer wants to return an item, needs a return label, or has questions about return policy.
Customer has problems with their Amazon account, including login issues, password resets, or account access.
Customer reports technical problems with the Amazon website, app, or services.
Customer asks about product availability, restocking, or general product questions.
Customer has questions or issues related to gift cards or gift certificates.
General questions or requests that don't fit into other specific categories.
